title: multi run --bare runs a bare twin of each agent at the same time, with none of the kb's tooling
goal: multi run SCENARIO --bare starts beside each kb agent a bare twin at the same time (with --sequential one pair at a time) with the same model, max turns and dollar cap, as claude -p with --setting-sources "", --settings '{"disableAllHooks": true}', --strict-mcp-config with no --mcp-config, --disable-slash-commands and --tools Read,Grep,Glob,Bash,Edit,Write,WebSearch,WebFetch, in its own sandbox under DIR/bare (an empty directory for a lookup or research twin, for a code twin a git checkout of the start commit without the public kb root, .claude, .claude-plugin, .mcp.json, CLAUDE.md or AGENTS.md and no hooks path) and no KB_ or CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ variable; --dry-run prints each twin's argv on a line `bare argv: ...`, its estimate on a line `bare estimate $X: <basis>` (a lookup twin's from the pool's web-<model> arm, a research or code twin's as its kb agent's) and the line `estimate: $K kb + $B bare = $T`; a lookup twin answers the same frozen questions from the web, a research twin researches the same area and writes its findings to NOTES.md in its sandbox, a code twin implements the same planted item from its spec (the gate's recommendation given as the operator's answer) and commits it with plain git; each line of DIR/results.jsonl names its arm (kb or bare), a twin's line its input, output, cache read and cache write counts, wall seconds, USD priced from those counts with bench_core.PRICE and its quality by the kb arm's rubric (right of asked by the same answer key, facts_matched of facts_verified as gate score answers, items_passed of items where the item's check passes in the twin's sandbox); multi record writes the twins' rows with arm `bare <the kb arm>` and the agent and run metrics input, out, cache_read, cache_write, usd, wall_s and the quality counts, the kb rows gaining only usd, facts_verified and items_passed; --replay --bare stands a scripted bare agent (bench_replay.py) in for each twin, so no model starts; multi remove removes DIR/bare too

run:
import sys
def _fail(t, e, tb, _d=sys.excepthook):
    if issubclass(t, AssertionError):
        print("check failed:", e); sys.exit(1)
    _d(t, e, tb)
sys.excepthook = _fail

import csv, json, os, re, shlex, shutil, subprocess, sys, tempfile
T = tempfile.mkdtemp()
B = os.path.join(T, "bin"); os.mkdir(B)
MARK = os.path.join(T, "claude-was-started")
open(os.path.join(B, "claude"), "w").write("#!/bin/sh\necho started >> " + MARK + "\nexit 1\n")
os.chmod(os.path.join(B, "claude"), 0o755)
ENV = dict(os.environ, PATH=B + os.pathsep + os.environ["PATH"])
def bench(*a, ok=(0,), timeout=1800):
    r = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "_tools/benchmarks.py", *a], capture_output=True, text=True, env=ENV, timeout=timeout)
    assert r.returncode in ok, (a, r.returncode, r.stdout[-800:], r.stderr[-800:])
    return r

TOOLS = {"Read", "Grep", "Glob", "Bash", "Edit", "Write", "WebSearch", "WebFetch"}
def flag(v, f):
    return v[v.index(f) + 1] if f in v else None
for s in ("lookups", "research", "mixed"):
    out = bench("multi", "run", s, "--dry-run", "--bare", "--dir", os.path.join(T, "d")).stdout
    lines = out.splitlines()
    kb = [shlex.split(l.split("argv:", 1)[1]) for l in lines if l.strip().startswith("argv:")]
    bare = [shlex.split(l.split("bare argv:", 1)[1]) for l in lines if "bare argv:" in l]
    assert bare and len(bare) == len(kb), (s, len(kb), len(bare), out[-800:])
    for k, v in zip(kb, bare):
        assert flag(v, "--setting-sources") == "", (s, v)
        assert json.loads(flag(v, "--settings") or "{}").get("disableAllHooks") is True, (s, v)
        assert "--strict-mcp-config" in v and "--mcp-config" not in v and "--plugin-dir" not in v, (s, v)
        assert not any("mcp__" in x for x in v), (s, v)
        assert set(re.split(r"[ ,]+", flag(v, "--tools") or "")) == TOOLS, (s, flag(v, "--tools"))
        assert flag(v, "--model") == flag(k, "--model") and flag(v, "--max-turns") == flag(k, "--max-turns"), (s, k, v)
        assert flag(v, "--max-budget-usd"), (s, v)
        if flag(k, "--max-budget-usd"):
            assert flag(v, "--max-budget-usd") == flag(k, "--max-budget-usd"), (s, k, v)
    assert re.search(r"estimate: \$[\d.]+ kb \+ \$[\d.]+ bare = \$[\d.]+", out), (s, out[-600:])
    if s == "lookups":
        assert any("bare estimate" in l and "web-" in l for l in lines), out[-800:]
assert not os.path.exists(MARK), "a dry run started claude"
print("dry runs ok")

import sys
def _fail(t, e, tb, _d=sys.excepthook):
    if issubclass(t, AssertionError):
        print("check failed:", e); sys.exit(1)
    _d(t, e, tb)
sys.excepthook = _fail

import csv, json, os, re, shlex, shutil, subprocess, sys, tempfile
T = tempfile.mkdtemp()
B = os.path.join(T, "bin"); os.mkdir(B)
MARK = os.path.join(T, "claude-was-started")
open(os.path.join(B, "claude"), "w").write("#!/bin/sh\necho started >> " + MARK + "\nexit 1\n")
os.chmod(os.path.join(B, "claude"), 0o755)
ENV = dict(os.environ, PATH=B + os.pathsep + os.environ["PATH"])
def bench(*a, ok=(0,), timeout=1800):
    r = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "_tools/benchmarks.py", *a], capture_output=True, text=True, env=ENV, timeout=timeout)
    assert r.returncode in ok, (a, r.returncode, r.stdout[-800:], r.stderr[-800:])
    return r

D, F = os.path.join(T, "r"), os.path.join(T, "rows.csv")
try:
    bench("multi", "run", "mixed", "--replay", "--bare", "--dir", D, timeout=3600)
    bench("multi", "record", "--dir", D, "--out", F)
    rows = list(csv.DictReader(open(F, encoding="utf-8")))
    bare = [r for r in rows if r["arm"].startswith("bare ")]
    kb = [r for r in rows if r["arm"].split(" ")[0] in ("concurrent", "sequential")]
    assert bare and kb, sorted({r["arm"] for r in rows})
    assert {r["arm"][5:] for r in bare} == {r["arm"] for r in kb}, "a bare arm is not named after its kb twin's arm"
    need = {"input", "out", "cache_read", "cache_write", "usd", "wall_s"}
    for side, sel, quality in (("kb", kb, {"right", "asked", "items_passed", "items", "facts_verified"}),
                               ("bare", bare, {"right", "asked", "items_passed", "items", "facts_matched", "facts_verified"})):
        m = {r["metric"] for r in sel}
        assert need | quality <= m, (side, sorted(need | quality - m))
        assert any(x.endswith("/usd") and "/" in x for x in m) and any(x.endswith("/cache_write") for x in m), (side, "no per-agent rows")
    with open(os.path.join(D, "results.jsonl"), encoding="utf-8") as f:
        lines = [json.loads(x) for x in f if x.strip()]
    assert any(x.get("arm") == "bare" for x in lines) and any(x.get("arm", "kb") == "kb" for x in lines), "results.jsonl names no arm"
finally:
    bench("multi", "remove", "--dir", D, ok=(0, 1))
assert not os.path.exists(D) or not os.listdir(D), "multi remove left the sandbox"
assert not os.path.exists(MARK), "the replay started claude"
print("replay ok")

notes: Operator request 2026-10-19, verbatim: "give the benchmark that will run today a parallel run of bare agents doing similar work -- need to compare token and dollar efficiency". Design (planned 2026-10-19): one twin per kb agent, started with it (concurrent: all kb agents and all twins at once; --sequential: kb agent N and its twin together, pair after pair), so both arms see the same host load. The twin has no kb tooling: no kb MCP server, no project or user settings, hooks, skills, plugin or coord store, no kb articles in its directory; web tools stay so it can look things up. The dollar figure is priced from the four usage counts with bench_core.PRICE for both arms (the session's own cost stays in `cost`). Gates score and arm answered by the operator's delegate with their recommendations (unattended overnight run, operator policy). Premise, run 2026-10-19 on origin/main: `benchmarks.py multi run lookups --dry-run --bare` exits 2 (unrecognized argument --bare): no bare arm exists. Spend: none, the checks run --dry-run and --replay only.
